newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India buys three Nov VLCCs Qua Iboe, four Dubais.
newsitem.headline: India buys three Nov VLCCs Qua Iboe, four Dubais.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) awarded three very large crude carriers (VLCC) of Qua Iboe crude in its November purchase tender, in addition to the four Dubai cargoes, industry sources said on Monday.

As reported on Friday, the IOC awarded four 500,000-barrel Dubai cargoes on the basis of first half November published quotes; to Conoco at +41 cents, to Phibro at +43 cents, Total at +44 cents and to Vitol at +44.8 cents.
But sources said India also awarded three VLCCs of Nigerian Qua Iboe crude.
Two VLCCs were awarded to Swiss trader Glencore, one at dated Brent +94.95 cents per barrel and the other at dated Brent +96.95 cents, the sources said.
A third VLCC was awarded to Dutch trader Vitol at dated Brent +$1.09 per barrel, industry sources said.
IOC received offers covering eight cargoes of Dubai crude and seven VLCCs od Qua Iboe.
Sources estimated that six Dubai cargoes have already been sold on the November spot market.
